{{Quote|This is Captain Feylara Raed of free trader Celestial Crow. If anyone's out there, I need help!|Felyara Raed|<ref name="Distressed" />}}
The '''''Celestial Crow''''' was a [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighter]] owned by [[Feylara Raed]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. One of [[Skavak/Legends|Skavak's]] lovers, Raed lured [[Voidhound|Skavak's rival]] to her ship by pretending that it was crippled, and [[Skirmish aboard the Celestial Crow|attempted]] to [[Death/Legends|kill]] the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] once they docked.<ref name="Distressed" />

{{Ship-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Celestial Crow'' first appeared in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|massively-multiplayer online role-playing video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', in the Smuggler Story mission "Distressed".<ref name="Distressed" />
